Sharing a workspace file by link or with named people.

## List a workspace's shares

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/shares` (SDK method `listShares`)

The live shares of the workspace's files, or of one file, with their invites. Needs viewer on it.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `workspaceId` | string | yes | The workspace's ID. |

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | no | Only this file's share. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [FileSharePage](/api/reference/types/#filesharepage) (`application/json`). The shares, oldest first.

**Errors**: `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Share a file

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/shares` (SDK method `shareFile`)

The file's share, made if it has none: a file has one live share, and sharing it again returns that one unchanged. A new share is `restricted` unless `access` says otherwise. Needs operator on the workspace's project, as a person (never an agent or an API key). Audited as `workspace.share.created`, without the token.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `workspaceId` | string | yes | The workspace's ID. |

**Body**: [ShareFileBody](/api/reference/types/#sharefilebody)

**Answers**

- `200`: [FileShare](/api/reference/types/#fileshare) (`application/json`). The file's share.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

**Errors**: `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Set a share's general access

`PATCH /v1/shares/{shareId}` (SDK method `updateShare`)

`link` lets anyone with the link read the file; `restricted` stops the link at once, and `link` again restarts the same link. Needs operator, as a person. Audited as `workspace.share.changed`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `shareId` | string | yes | The share's ID. |

**Body**: [UpdateShareBody](/api/reference/types/#updatesharebody)

**Answers**

- `200`: [FileShare](/api/reference/types/#fileshare) (`application/json`). The share as changed.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Revoke a share

`DELETE /v1/shares/{shareId}` (SDK method `revokeShare`)

Its link stops for good; sharing the file again makes a new link. Needs operator, as a person. Audited as `workspace.share.revoked`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `shareId` | string | yes | The share's ID. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [FileShare](/api/reference/types/#fileshare) (`application/json`). The revoked share.

**Errors**: `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Invite someone by email

`POST /v1/shares/{shareId}/invites` (SDK method `inviteToShare`)

Adds the email to the share's invites (one already invited stays as it is). Harbour stores and lists invites but sends no email, and an invite grants no access of its own. Needs operator, as a person.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `shareId` | string | yes | The share's ID. |

**Body**: [ShareInviteBody](/api/reference/types/#shareinvitebody)

**Answers**

- `200`: [FileShare](/api/reference/types/#fileshare) (`application/json`). The share with its invites.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).
